description:
Área: Desenvolvimento de Software

Sobre a posição

Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile Pleno/Sênior

Local: Híbrido – Rio de Janeiro

Modelo: CLT/PJ

Área: Desenvolvimento de Software

Sobre a posição

Procuramos um(a) dev mobile que não foge da daily , já fez as pazes com o Ionic (ou ao menos tenta ) e curte colocar app na loja sem perder a sanidade no caminho.

Aqui, você vai meter a mão no código, propor melhorias, refatorar aquele “if” suspeito e ajudar a gente a manter o mobile com cara de 2025 (e não de 2012). Tudo isso junto com um time multidisciplinar que valoriza boas práticas, mas também adora um bom meme no Slack.

Responsabilidades (ou “o rolê”):

Desenvolver e manter apps híbridos (Ionic/Angular/Capacitor).

Integrar com Web APIs em C#/.NET e garantir performance.

️ Automatizar builds e releases (App Store, Google Play, TestFlight).

️ Refatorar, revisar e sugerir arquiteturas melhores que “funcionou no meu PC”.

Apoiar boas práticas (clean code, SOLID, testes e menos gambi).

Participar das cerimônias ágeis (sem dormir na retrospectiva, por favor ).

Garantir qualidade com testes e monitoramento (nada de “confia que roda”).

Trabalhar junto com POs, designers e devs para entregar apps sólidos e bonitos.

Requisitos (o que esperamos que você saiba fazer):

️ Experiência em desenvolvimento mobile híbrido (Ionic/Angular/Capacitor).

️ Conhecimento em C#/.NET e APIs RESTful.

️ Já ter sofrido com CI/CD, TestFlight, App Store e Google Play Console.

️ Refatoração, boas práticas, SOLID e clean code na veia.

️ Experiência com testes (unitários, integrados e automatizados).

️ Publicação/distribuição de apps sem surtar.

️ Vivência em ágil (Scrum/Kanban).

Diferenciais (aquele brilho extra):

Experiência com macOS para builds iOS.

️ Conhecimento em Clean Architecture, DDD, MVVM.

Monitoramento com AppCenter ou Firebase Crashlytics.

Experiência com ambientes escaláveis.

Segurança e boas práticas em APIs Mobile.

O que oferecemos

Ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico (sem microgerenciamento chato).

Projetos de impacto e alcance real.

Espaço para inovação, autonomia e crescimento.

E, claro, um time que sabe a diferença entre bug e feature (quase sempre).

  • Se você é do tipo que gosta de código limpo, apps bem feitos e squads que entregam com qualidade (e umas piadas ruins no meio), essa vaga é pra você!

description:

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products. In addition, you will help write Juju charms to manage operational concerns.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Write Juju charms (operators) to manage operational concerns
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction
description:
Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 Purpose
The successful candidate will play a critical role in the design, synthesis, and characterization of novel nanomaterials for drug delivery applications, as well as the development of advanced chemical biology tools. This individual will be responsible for applying expertise in nanoparticle production, fluorescent labeling strategies for biomolecules, and robust bioconjugate synthesis to advance our pipeline of innovative therapeutics and diagnostics.
Supervisory Authority
This position may involve supervising undergraduate and graduate students.
Nature And Scope
Internal contacts include Jacqueline Smith. External contacts include N/A.
Principal Accountabilities
The Research Scientist will be responsible for the following.
  • Design, synthesize, and characterize various types of nanoparticles (e.g., liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, inorganic nanoparticles) for targeted drug delivery, gene therapy, or diagnostic imaging applications.
  • Optimize nanoparticle formulation parameters (size, morphology, surface charge, drug loading, release kinetics) for desired in vitro and in vivo performance.
  • Develop and implement robust analytical methods for nanoparticle characterization (e.g., DLS, TEM, SEM, HPLC, UV-Vis, fluorescence spectroscopy).
  • Evaluate the stability, biocompatibility, and efficacy of nanoparticle-based systems.
  • Develop and optimize strategies for site-specific and quantitative fluorescent labeling of peptides, proteins, antibodies, and other biomolecules.
  • Work with a variety of fluorescent dyes and fluorophores, including organic dyes, quantum dots, and fluorescent proteins.
  • Characterize labeled biomolecules for purity, integrity, and functionality using techniques such as gel electrophoresis, mass spectrometry, and fluorescence spectroscopy.
  • Design and execute synthetic routes for the efficient and reproducible conjugation of various molecules (e.g., drugs, targeting ligands, imaging agents) to nanoparticles, peptides, proteins, and other biomolecules.
  • Utilize a range of bioconjugation chemistries (e.g., click chemistry, amide coupling, maleimide chemistry, hydrazone formation) to achieve desired conjugation outcomes.
  • Purify and characterize bioconjugates using appropriate chromatographic and spectroscopic methods.
  • Design and synthesize novel small molecules, linkers, and probes for various biological applications.
  • Presenting research findings at regular group meetings, as well as local and national conferences
  • Publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals
Core Competencies
  • Extensive hands-on experience with the synthesis, characterization, and application of various nanoparticle systems for drug delivery (e.g., liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, micelles, dendrimers).
  • Proficiency in a wide range of analytical techniques for nanoparticle characterization (e.g., DLS, TEM, SEM, cryo-TEM, HPLC, FPLC, UV-Vis, fluorescence spectroscopy, zeta potential).
  • Demonstrated expertise in diverse bioconjugation chemistries (e.g., EDC/NHS, maleimide-thiol, click chemistry, hydrazone, oxime ligations).
  • Proven ability to design and execute strategies for fluorescent labeling of peptides, proteins, and other biomolecules.
  • Strong background in organic synthesis and purification techniques (e.g., column chromatography, HPLC, LC-MS).
  • Solid understanding of biomolecular interactions and protein chemistry.
  • Proficiency in data analysis software and scientific literature databases.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a commitment to scientific rigor.
Minimum Requirements
M.S. in Chemical Biology or Biochemistry and 1-2 years of experience or Ph.D. Chemical Biology or Biochemistry

The Senior Associate Director of Scholarships is responsible for managing the Scholarship Team. title: ANALISTA DE PRICING SENIOR - TRANSPORTE RODOVIARIO
description:
Há mais de 28 anos, o Grupo CET LOGISTICS está presente no Comércio Exterior tendo iniciado suas atividades no segmento de Óleo e Gás, especializando-se em grandes projetos e, atualmente, é especializado também em logística integrada e internacional em transporte de mercadorias multimodal, presente nas áreas comerciais mais importantes do mundo.
O Grupo está envolvido em projetos globais para as mais diversas indústrias, desenvolvendo serviços porta a porta que incluem: coleta de carga em sua origem, planejamento estratégico, distribuição, rastreamento, expedição e desembaraço aduaneiro.
Nos últimos anos, a CET expandiu significativamente sua área de especialização, com grande knowhow e uma excelente reputação no mercado, oferecendo a seus clientes soluções personalizadas em toda a cadeia logística, com qualidade, agilidade, responsabilidade e transparência. Nossos escritórios e hubs estão situados no Rio de Janeiro/Brasil, Houston/EUA e Roterdã/Holanda.
Hoje a CET atende sua base de clientes com mais de 250 especialistas em logística presentes em diferentes regiões do globo.
Conheça mais sobre a CET LOGISTICS e todos os nossos serviços no site:
De Atividades

  • Elaborar propostas comerciais e cálculos de frete para clientes estratégicos, baseando-se em análises de custo, capacidade operacional e viabilidade econômica;
  • Desenvolver, manter e aprimorar ferramentas de simulação de preços e margens, garantindo maior agilidade e assertividade na formação de preços;
  • Realizar análises comparativas de mercado (benchmarking) e estudos de sensibilidade para embasar decisões de revisão de tabelas tarifárias;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de rentabilidade por cliente, rota e tipo de serviço, propondo ajustes quando necessário;
  • Suportar o time comercial em negociações, fornecendo análises de impacto financeiro e cenários alternativos de pricing;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas como Operações, Financeiro, Fiscal e TI para garantir que os preços estejam aderentes aos custos e regras tributárias;
  • Avaliar contratos existentes e sugerir revisões com base em performance, reajustes e desvios de rentabilidade;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de precificação e implantação de práticas de pricing dinâmico, sempre que possível;
  • Liderar projetos de reestruturação de pricing ou análise de novos modelos de negócio.
Competências
  • Pensamento crítico: questiona, analisa e recalcula;
  • Comunicação clara e firme: sabe traduzir planilha para quem vive na estrada;
  • Agilidade e organização: lida com prazos apertados, mas entrega com exatidão;
  • Influência e negociação: sabe dizer "não" com fundamento e apresentar alternativas viáveis;
  • Curiosidade e melhoria contínua: busca sempre como precificar melhor e mais rápido.
Requisitos
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel avançado; domínio de ferramentas como Power BI, Access, VBA ou SQL é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento profundo em custos logísticos, tabelas de frete, modais (rodoviário, aéreo, marítimo), impostos (ICMS, ISS, etc.);
  • Experiência prévia sólida em precificação de serviços logísticos ou transporte de cargas;
Benefícios
Benefícios
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte.

A Onet Brasil está com vaga aberta para atuar como Auxiliar de Manutenção Civil.

Nossa empresa acredita na diversidade e na inclusão de todos. Por isso, as vagas abertas também são para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD).

Atividades:

  • Apoiar em diversas áreas da manutenção predial e da construção civil;

Nossa missão é criar ambientes mais agradáveis, saudáveis e seguros para todos. Isso começa com a valorização do potencial humano. Priorizamos o crescimento organizacional e o bem-estar de nossas equipes, promovendo a motivação, o engajamento e a busca constante pela excelência e superação de resultados.

Para cumprir essa missão, nossa área de Recursos Humanos oferece oportunidades de crescimento na carreira, programas de treinamento sob medida às necessidades dos clientes e um contínuo desenvolvimento do nosso capital humano.

Assentar tijolos, ladrilhos ou pedras; Rebocar as estruturas construídas; Aplicar camadas de cimento, assentamento de ladrilhos ou materiais similares.

Realizar manutenção corretiva em prédios, calçadas e estruturas semelhantes, reparando paredes, pisos, trocando telhas, aparelhos sanitários, manilhas e outras peças, além de chumbamento de bases danificadas.

Montar e desmontar andaimes de madeira ou metálicos.

Zelar pela conservação e limpeza do material e do local de trabalho.

Executar outras tarefas relacionadas ao cargo.

Realizar manutenções hidráulicas (troca de sifão, reparo em torneira, desentupimento de vaso e mictório, troca de assento, entre outros) e pequenos reparos civis (pintura, troca de forro, entre outros).

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.
LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.
Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.
What you will focus on

  • Lead a team of remote engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Participate in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Work from home with global travel for 4 to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • 2 Manage emergency response with due regard for safety of personnel, FSO/FPSO and environment
  • 3 Demonstrate knowledge and awareness of potential emergency scenarios.
  • 4 Contribute to the effective de-brief and analysis of exercises.
  • 4) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  • 1 Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits

The Product Manager for Elfie Research will design and deliver study-specific product experiences that align with clinical protocols while keeping participants engaged. You’ll bridge clinical science and user behavior—customizing Elfie’s features to support data collection, adherence, and study success. Bridge the clinical and consumer worlds by translating study protocols into engaging, user-friendly product experiences that align with patient needs and behavior

Customize Elfie’s features —including health programs, wellness journeys, and engagement mechanisms—to meet the specific requirements of each research protocol

Collaborate closely with clinical researchers, scientific advisors, and external study partners to ensure product compliance with study standards and ethical guidelines

Work directly with the internal Elfie Research business unit to support broader goals such as generating publishable outcomes and advancing Elfie’s scientific credibility

Product & project management

5+ years of experience in product or program management, ideally in digital health, clinical research, or healthcare technology

Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects from scoping to execution, under strict timelines

Demonstrated experience delivering user-facing features or workflows with measurable outcomes

Clinical study understanding

Strong familiarity with clinical study protocols, trial phases, and compliance considerations (GCP, informed consent, etc.)

Experience working with or supporting clinical operations, digital health research, or patient-centered trials is a strong plus

User-centered product thinking

Ability to translate scientific requirements into intuitive, engaging user journeys and behavior-supportive product flows

Skilled in customizing existing product systems (e.g., programs, engagement tools) to align with research-specific needs

Cross-functional & stakeholder collaboration

Excellent communication skills in English, with experience working directly with clinical researchers, external partners, and internal stakeholders

Comfortable aligning product, data, content, and engineering teams toward common study objectives

Technical & analytical fluency

Comfortable working with data teams to define tracking frameworks for clinical endpoints and user activity

Proficiency in tools like Figma, Notion, and product analytics platforms is a plus

Preferred Background

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Product, Public Health, Life Sciences, Engineering, or similar); advanced degree is a plus

description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.


Main responsibilities

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade éa sua chance. Nessa posição deAnalista de Faturamento Sênior,você vai somar ao time Finanças que tem comoobjetivo Garantir a assertividade da receita bem como as rotinas de Faturamento e Contas a Receber.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Garantir que as áreas especialistas tenham conhecimento dos insumos necessários para o reconhecimento da receita (competência, valor das campanhas, pedidos de inserção, etc.), por meio de reuniões semanais;
  • Garantir a aderência ao cronograma de faturamento, com reuniões semanais para cumprimento dos prazos da empresa;
  • Garantir a assertividade na contabilização da provisão de receita, faturamento e ajustes, acompanhando relatórios sistêmicos e gerenciais;
  • Executar as rotinas de faturamento e contas a receber (receita nacional e internacional), acompanhando e ajustando os prazos e prioridades estipulados pela empresa;
  • Atuar nas renegociações dos contratos da área de Faturamento;
  • Apoiar as demandas da auditoria interna e externa;
  • Acompanhar e atuar de forma proativa nas metas (OKR), através de solicitações e implantações de melhorias em sistemas e processos (integração da receita de vendas online para o ERP, implantação da ferramenta de conciliação de recebimentos, enriquecimento da base do ERP com informações da receita por vertical, etc.);
  • Elaborar e atualizar os arquivos com relatórios da área (Taxa de Conversão, Prazo Médio de Recebimento, Receita por Vertical, etc.);
  • Garantir o fechamento mensal da receita e realizar as validações necessárias para assegurar que as informações financeiras sejam refletidas de forma integral no balanço;

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Atuação com área Administrativa e/ou Financeira;
  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo em áreas de Exatas (Economia, Contabilidade, Administração, Engenharia, Atuária, etc.);
  • Experiência: Faturamento, contas a receber, garantia de receita e conhecimento em processos de reconhecimento de receita e recebíveis;
  • Ferramentas: Domínio do Pacote Office e sistemas ERP;
  • De 4 a 6 anos de experiencia em Faturamento.

O que será um diferencial?

  • Pós-graduação: Desejável especialização (MBA, Mestrado, Doutorado) em Finanças.

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

description:
Ceragon (NASDAQ: CRNT) is a global innovator and leading solutions provider of end-to-end wireless connectivity, specializing in transport, access, and AI-powered managed & professional services. We empower customers to enhance operational efficiency and enrich end-user experience through our innovative solutions.

Our clients include service providers, utilities, public safety organizations, government agencies, energy companies, and more. They rely on our expertise in 5G & 4G broadband wireless connectivity, mission-critical services, and applications leveraging ultra-high reliability and speed. Ceragon solutions are deployed by over 600 service providers and 1,600 private network owners across more than 130 countries.

Our end-to-end solutions, encompassing hardware, software, and managed & professional services, enable customers to confidently adopt future wireless technologies, shaping next-generation connectivity and service delivery. Ceragon offers reliable, rapid-deployment, high-capacity wireless solutions for diverse communication network use cases, designed to lower TCO by minimizing spectrum, power, real estate, and labor resources—facilitating quick, cost-effective network modernization and establishing Ceragon as a leading provider in the "connectivity everywhere" era.

Position is located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil .

We are seeking a qualified NoC Team Leader to join our team. The role involves coordinating and overseeing the front office team to ensure optimal network operation and managed service delivery, along with efficient workflow management.

Your key duties and responsibilities include:

  • Setting clear team goals and KPIs aligned with customer SLA commitments.
  • Organizing and assigning tasks to NoC team members.
  • Monitoring team performance during shifts to ensure smooth operations and timely, accurate task completion.
  • Handling network outage crises and applying appropriate crisis management strategies.
  • Conducting performance evaluations and providing feedback to team members.
  • Creating a motivating and healthy work environment.
  • Monitoring team performance metrics and reporting on them.
  • Identifying training needs and coaching team members accordingly.
  • Gathering feedback and resolving issues or conflicts within the team.
  • Providing network and audit reports related to network operations and team performance.
  • Identifying opportunities for improvement and acting on them.

description:

Responsabilidades Da Posição
A Drogaria Venancio busca um Assistente de Contas a Receber para se juntar à nossa equipe financeira . Nossa equipe é dinâmica e inovadora , e estamos procurando por alguém que compartilhe nossa paixão por excelência . Como Assistente de Contas a Receber, você será responsável por recebimentos de valores , apuração de valores e realização de encontro de contas .
Se você é uma pessoa organizada , detalhista e com experiência em contas a receber, nós queremos ouvir de você ! Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e oportunidades de crescimento .
Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição

  • Experiência em contas a receber - Mínimo de 1 ano
  • Comunicação eficaz - Para lidar com clientes e equipe interna
  • Organização e planejamento - Para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas
Sobre a Empresa
Cuidando de você, sempre!
Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca que, há mais de 45 anos, coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. Com mais de 135 lojas físicas e ao mesmo tempo mais de 4.900 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios e Volta Redonda.
Além disso, nossos canais digitais ampliam nossa atuação para mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil.
Nosso propósito? Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Acreditamos que saúde vai além dos medicamentos: é qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar.
Em 2014, criamos a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio focada no mercado hospitalar e na distribuição farmacêutica, garantindo um serviço especializado e eficiente. Para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição, estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.
O que nos torna únicos? Nossa essência carioca, o acolhimento genuíno e a busca constante pela inovação. Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e ganhamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importante.
A Venancio não para! Até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos expandindo nossa presença no mercado, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.
Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha crescer com a gente!

As a Critical Environment Field Service Engineer , you would be responsible for overseeing the maintenance and operation of all machinery that supports the critical load inside a Data Center.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a Datacenter or other critical environment facility, working with the operation of building cooling, electrical, mechanical, and life safety systems, Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), Branch Circuit Monitoring (BCM), Building Automation Systems (BAS), and Battery Monitoring Systems (BMS)
  • Technical College degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • Able to communicate well in English and Portuguese in both written and spoken form.
  • Able to work 100% on site in Rio de Janeiro.

Amagi is a market leader in cloud-based media technology services for channel creation, distribution, and ad monetization. Amagi's cloud technology and managed services are used by TV networks, content owners, and CTV / OTT platforms to create 24x7 linear channels for OTT and broadcast distribution. Amagi delivers unified cloud solutions for channel creation, distribution, and advertisement via its lineup of versatile products, including Amagi CLOUDPORT and Amagi THUNDERSTORM.

Amagi's pioneering and market-leading cloud platform has won numerous accolades and is deployed in over 40 countries by 600+ TV networks. Customers of Amagi include A+E Networks, Comcast, Cox Media Group, Google, NBC Universal, Roku, Samsung, Warner Media, and many more.

This role provides a unique and transformative opportunity to grow a world-class technology organization by innovating how content is originated, distributed, and monetized. Amagi has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, New Delhi, and Bangalore.

About The Role

As a Sr. Systems Engineer at Amagi, you will serve as a trusted advisor to our broadcast customers, leveraging your deep expertise in broadcast engineering and streaming technologies to address customer challenges and drive adoption of Amagi's cloud-based media technology solutions. You will be responsible for the technical aspects of the pre-sales process, ensuring seamless integration and alignment of our products with customer needs, while representing Amagi's innovative broadcast solutions in the market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Act as the primary technical resource for the sales team, providing expert guidance on broadcast automation, playout, live production, graphics, distribution, and streaming technologies
  • Solution Design & POCs: Collaborate with clients to understand their broadcast and streaming needs, design tailored solutions, and create customer-focused Proofs of Concept (POCs) with clearly defined success criteria
  • Pre-Sales Support: Lead technical discussions during the pre-sales process, including gathering customer requirements, conducting technical demos, and responding to Requests for Proposals (RFPs). Manage technical customer engagement and ensure a smooth handoff to the onboarding team
  • Product Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of Amagi's products and services, including Amagi CLOUDPORT and Amagi THUNDERSTORM, to build and deliver curated demos, technical presentations, and training materials
  • Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a technical advisor and ensuring their long-term success with Amagi's broadcast solutions
  • Industry Engagement: Represent Amagi at trade shows, conferences, and technical forums, demonstrating our product capabilities and staying current with industry trends and best practices
  • Feedback & Development: Gather and communicate client feedback to the product development team, helping to influence product enhancements and ensuring our solutions meet market demands.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Manage Pre-Sales Engagements: Oversee multiple customer opportunities and related projects, prioritizing work and proactively escalating risks in consultation with the manager and sales teams
  • Single Point of Contact: Serve as the main technical contact for customers during the pre-sales process, engaging subject matter experts (SMEs) as needed for complex discussions or architecture reviews
  • Discovery & Documentation: Participate in discovery calls, accurately document customer requirements, and create technical Statements of Work (SOWs) for proposed solutions
  • Product Gap Analysis: Identify product gaps, create internal cases, and collaborate with the product team on feature requests and prioritization
  • Escalation Support: Provide technical support during customer escalations and collaborate with global internal teams during non-working hours if needed
  • Content Development: Develop technical collateral, including blog posts, training materials, and demos, to support internal and external enablement efforts
  • Continuous Improvement: Regularly provide feedback to enhance the pre-sales engineering process and improve product and technical documentation

Requirements

Education : Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent years of relevant experience.

Experience : 7+ years in media & entertainment technologies, with 5+ years in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or broadcast engineering.

MUST have Technical Skills :

  • Subject matter expertise in broadcast automation, playout, live production, graphics, and distribution workflows
  • Strong understanding of streaming media technologies and ad monetization
  • Familiarity with cloud services (e.g., AWS, GCP) and tools such as Linux, automation tools (e.g., Pulumi, Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible), scripting languages (e.g., Ruby, Python), workflows (e.g., Argo CI/CD, GitOps), or containerized services (e.g., Kubernetes) is desirable
  • Tools Proficiency: Familiarity with sales and software engineering tools such as Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence
  • Language Skills: Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory; proficiency in Spanish is a plus
  • Communication Skills: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely in written and verbal form, including technical instructions and product descriptions
  • Problem-Solving & Time Management: Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving client challenges. Ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, with excellent multitasking and time management skills

Additional Requirements

  • Must have worked with a broadcast vendor or a customer in broadcast engineering
  • Knowledge of broadcast operations is highly desirable
  • Professional certifications in public cloud technologies are a plus
  • No visa sponsorship or moving allowance is available

Why Join Amagi?

  • Innovative Environment: Be part of Amagi's story at the forefront of cloud-based broadcast and streaming technology innovation
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement in a rapidly growing industry
  • Collaborative Culture: Work with a passionate team dedicated to delivering success for our clients and driving innovation in the media technology space

title: Analista de Segurança Eletrônica - Data Centers
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company, enabling connectivity to foster innovations that enrich our work, life, and planet.

We welcome bold ideas, value human connection, and offer opportunities for everyone to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the forefront of shaping the future and enhancing customer value through innovation. You will collaborate across teams, influence decisions, and help define the path forward. Join us to find belonging, purpose, and a supportive team — because when you feel valued, you can do your best work.

Resumo da Posição

A equipe de Segurança Eletrônica é responsável por fornecer suporte técnico e operacional diário às operações de segurança física dos data centers, garantindo atendimento às metas de desempenho relacionadas à satisfação do cliente, disponibilidade, responsabilidade fiscal, capacidade de resposta e trabalho em equipe. Essa posição trabalha colaborativamente com diversas áreas internas e externas, como Cyber Security, Global Risk, IBX Operations, Design & Construction, Sales, Customer Care, entre outras, para atender às necessidades de segurança física e conformidade da empresa.

Responsabilidades

Ordens de Serviço

  • Apoiar instalações e desinstalações de segurança de complexidade moderada.
  • Gerenciar solicitações de trabalho não padronizadas, internas e externas, incluindo coordenação com fornecedores.
  • Acompanhar pedidos de segurança de clientes, incluindo requisitos de relatórios e auditorias.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e distribuição de RFPs para projetos de infraestrutura de segurança.
  • Coordenar equipamentos auxiliares e realizar pequenos reparos para minimizar tempo de inatividade.

Gestão de Incidentes

  • Responder a incidentes de segurança no local de complexidade moderada.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e análises de causa raiz.
  • Aplicar a matriz de decisão de incidentes de segurança e coordenar com o Equinix Operations Center (EOC).

Manutenção de Infraestrutura

  • Resolver problemas moderados relacionados ao sistema de controle de acesso (ACS) e sistema de gerenciamento de vídeo (VMS).
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva conforme procedimentos operacionais padrão.
  • Atender solicitações de suporte ao cliente, como auditorias e pedidos personalizados de segurança.
  • Gerenciar inventário de ativos e endereços IP de equipamentos de segurança.

Gestão de Fornecedores

  • Apoiar trabalhos de fornecedores relacionados a projetos de segurança voltados ao cliente e infraestrutura interna.
  • Coordenar com a equipe de gestão do site para atender requisitos de auditorias internas e externas.

Administração do Site

  • Garantir conformidade com processos e procedimentos de segurança e iniciativas de controle de qualidade.
  • Analisar e manter desenhos e documentação de suporte específicos do site.

Colaboração

  • Apoiar stakeholders durante atividades de manutenção.
  • Comunicar-se com equipes para coordenar instalações de segurança que impactam a infraestrutura.
  • Colaborar na implementação e validação de atualizações de sistemas.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multifuncionais em novas construções e expansões.

Requisitos

  • Vivência prática em instalação e manutenção de sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, com conhecimento técnico em cabeamento estruturado, redes IP e eletrônica aplicada à segurança física.
  • Experiência consolidada em ambientes operacionais, com atuação direta em projetos de infraestrutura de segurança.
  • Conhecimento substancial em procedimentos operacionais padrão de segurança física.
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas moderadamente complexos com julgamento e autonomia.
  • Habilidade para colaborar com diversas áreas e comunicar-se de forma eficaz.
  • Comunicação e compreensão do Idioma inglês será considerado um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencialmente nos Data Centers da Equinix em São Paulo e Barueri.

Equinix está comprometida em garantir que nosso processo de recrutamento seja acessível a todos, incluindo pessoas com deficiência. Se você é um candidato qualificado e necessita de assistência ou acomodação, por favor, informe-nos preenchendo este formulário .

A Equinix é uma empregadora que promove a igualdade de oportunidades de emprego e, nos EUA, uma empregadora de Ação Afirmativa. Todos os candidatos qualificados receberão consideração para emprego sem distinção de raça, cor, religião, origem étnica, nacionalidade, sexo, gravidez, condições médicas relacionadas, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, estado civil, status de veterano ou militar, deficiência física ou mental, informações genéticas, filiação política/organizacional, condição de vítima ou familiar de vítima de crime ou abuso, ou qualquer outra condição protegida por lei aplicável.

About Donorbox
Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to close to $3B in donations.
Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries.
Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews. We're proud of what we do, and our product reflects it!
The Role
Donorbox is seeking a Product Analyst to join our growing team. Reporting directly to the Director of Product, the person will be a key player in helping our product teams make data-driven decisions. The role's primary focus will be on defining, implementing, and analyzing product metrics such as in-app events and conversion funnels. The person will also be responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of our data collection, acting as a crucial link between our Product and Data departments. They will work closely with product managers and designers to provide the insights they need to build and iterate on successful features, and track the key results for each objective of every product team.
Responsibilities

  • Define and track key product success metrics across various product teams, including quarterly OKRs.
  • Work with product managers to establish, implement, and analyze product conversion funnels.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure accurate and complete data collection for all new product launches and feature updates.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for product usage data requests from the design team, providing them with the necessary insights to inform their decisions.
  • Bridge the communication and technical gap between the Product and Data departments, translating business needs into data requirements.
  • Monitor data quality and integrity, troubleshooting and resolving any issues related to event tracking or data loss.
  • Assist in setting up and analyzing A/B tests and other experimental feature rollouts.
  • Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards on product performance to stakeholders.
Qualifications & Experience
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Product Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Deep expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Hands-on experience with advanced product analytics tools like Heap, Posthog, or Pendo, including successful implementation and ongoing use.
  • Experience with A/B testing and feature rollout platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Experience with SQL for data querying and analysis.
Bonus
  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in a high-growth or startup environment.
  • Knowledge of scripting languages like Python or R for data analysis.
  • Background in user experience (UX) or product design.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.

  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes
  • Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
Job Summary
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.
As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations
What we are looking for in you
  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Data Scientist (Brazil) Rio de Janeiro
description:
place Oslo, Norway

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for checking the accuracy of import/export recordkeeping.
  • Manage, request, and compile necessary import documentation to ensure entry accuracy.
  • Partner with different teams like sales and customer services teams on due diligence process, including but not limited to Know your customer, screening, and vetting.
  • Support local entity’s participation on FTA (Free trade agreement) under the guidance from Corp. compliance and partner with functional teams on the necessary supporting calculation and collection.
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure accurate Harmonized Tariff classifications, maintain internal classification databases and ensure accuracy of customs entries.
  • Assist in maintaining part databases with global trade compliance data including product classifications, HTS Codes, and country of origin classifications.

  • Manage the proper reporting of assists as related to Dover trade compliance policy.
  • Provide training with the support from corporate compliance team to local entities on different trade compliance topic.
  • General compliance support, including VC (screening tool), TPG (3rdparty vetting platform), code of conduct, conflict of interest, training etc.
  • Other duties pertaining to corporate compliance as assigned.

Qualifications/Experience Requirements:

  • Additional experience in supply chain, traffic, logistics, business is highly desired.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with a positive, team-oriented approach.
  • Ability to assess risk and recommend actions and strategies to mitigate regulatory risks.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently on multiple tasks to meet deadlines, prioritize, and maintain flexibility in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in tariff classification and country of origin determination. Engineering background in HTS Classification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of documentation requirements and Brazil Customs regulations.
  • Data analysis and Excel skills proficiency.
  • Brazil Customs Brokerage License not required, but highly desirable.
  • Impeccable ethics and trustworthiness.

title: Analista Sr de Gestão de Contas, MVR
description:
Job ID: | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

Esta vaga tem o objetivo de coletar talentos para futuras posições.

A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho. Atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e dos clientes que atendemos. No Brasil, estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de diferentes áreas e cargos, pois acreditamos que essa agenda necessita de várias perspectivas e vivências. Nossa liderança é engajada e compreende seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos princípios de liderança, com o objetivo de sermos "a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo". Reconhecemos nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança, conscientes de que "Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades". Nossos grupos de afinidade, formados por voluntários de várias unidades de negócio, participam ativamente na definição das estratégias de DEI, atuando como embaixadores dessa agenda e apoiando desde o Day 1. Os grupos incluem: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e Pessoa com Deficiência.

Procuramos um profissional para atuar como Analista Sênior de Gestão de Contas, desempenhando papel crucial na equipe de Massive Vendor Recruitment (MVR), responsável por criar parcerias sólidas e acelerar o crescimento de fornecedores de alto potencial para nosso negócio.

O time de MVR trabalha em programas como Selection, Qualidade de Catálogo, Eficiência Operacional, Disponibilidade e Rentabilidade, colaborando com as equipes de Produtos e centrais para atingir nossos objetivos.

Desafios da Função:

  • Gestão de Fornecedores: Desenvolver planos personalizados de aceleração e crescimento para cada fornecedor.
  • Negociações e Planejamento: Liderar negociações de compras a médio e longo prazo, criar planos de investimento do fornecedor, incluindo orçamentos de vendas, resultados e marketing.
  • Estratégias e Análises: Estabelecer estratégias inovadoras, analisar dados de negócios e planejar ações de impulsionamento do desempenho dos fornecedores.
  • Promoções e Ofertas: Elaborar ofertas e promoções, identificando oportunidades de crescimento para nossos parceiros e para a Amazon.com.br.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Acelerar a aquisição de seleção relevante e promover o crescimento de cada fornecedor;
  • Gerenciar fornecedores de uma Família de Produtos específica, sendo responsável pelo P&L do negócio;
  • Garantir os principais resultados operacionais e financeiros, desenvolvendo planos para impulsionar receita e melhorar margens;
  • Atuar como hunter e/ou farmer, desenvolvendo e graduando fornecedores em nossos programas internos;
  • Gerenciar métricas de performance, eliminar obstáculos operacionais e identificar oportunidades de demanda;
  • Realizar onboarding de novos fabricantes, contribuindo para a meta de nova seleção e melhor custo, aumentando a conversão do catálogo.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior concluído;
  • Experiência em gestão de contas, gerenciamento de produtos ou programas;
  • Atuação com gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Capacidade de analisar KPIs e gerar insights;
  • Experiência em negociações com fornecedores, preços, promoções, gestão de estoque e desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Excel intermediário;
  • Proficiência avançada em Excel;
  • Conhecimento de SQL;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.

Partner with the best

As a Aeroderivative turbine Mechanical Field Service Engineer, you will be the first point of contact for our global customers on-site.

  • Comandar, supervisionar e executar operação das instalações pertencentes à rede de operação através do Sistema de supervisão e controle e software de gestão de ativos;

Disponibilidade para atuar no Centro, Rio de Janeiro.

Somos uma empresa que participa no desenvolvimento, investimento e gestão de ativos de infraestrutura.

Nossa filosofia baseia-se em:

Capacidade de gerar fluxo de caixa previsíveis a longo prazo.

Melhorar a sustentabilidade do mercado.

Nossos ativos estão centrados majoritariamente na transmissão e na geração de energia renovável no âmbito de programas de parceria público-privada.

Atualmente, a Celeo participa na construção e exploração de sistemas de transmissão de energia e geração renovável no âmbito internacional, com ativos na Espanha , Chile , Peru e Brasil , mantendo diversas atividades de promoção em outros mercados da América Latina.

title: Field Quality Specialist
description:
Do you enjoy being part of a successful team?

Do you like working in collaborative teams and solving technical problems?

Join our Turbomachinery Team!

At Baker Hughes, our purpose is clear. We take energy forward – making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet. Our Turbomachinery & Process Solutions team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize energy extraction, production, and processing.


Partner with the best

This position will coordinate and oversee work at a field site, providing quality service to the customer.


Partner with the best

As a Quality Control Specialist, you will coordinate and oversee work at a field site, providing quality service to the customer. Your role may include sales, job design, execution, and follow-up activities. You will plan the job, including instructions to the crew and equipment used. You will coordinate and direct the activities of service operators, oversee equipment cleanup, repair, and preparation for the next job.

As a Quality Control Specialist, you will be responsible for:

  • Performing minor/major maintenance of equipment following the Service Site Quality Check Lists and procedures.
  • Being the primary contact to work with the Customer Representative and Site Team to coordinate activities at the Customer Job Site.
  • Providing records of all activities at the Customer Site to the Baker Hughes TPS Supervisor and maintaining good team relations.
  • Executing all responsibilities safely by following all applicable processes and procedures.
  • Performing other duties as required within the scope of work.
  • Providing limited troubleshooting on equipment under maintenance or installation in the field.
  • Conducting all activities in accordance with Baker Hughes Core Values (HSE, Quality, and Compliance).


Fuel your passion

To succeed in this role, you should:

  • Have experience in the quality sector within the industry.
  • Have engineering or technical training in mechanics, mechatronics, or electromechanics.
  • Possess CREA or CFT certifications.
  • Be capable of working under pressure with clear thinking and decisiveness. Be a team player.
  • Be willing and able to work on Field Service outages 70-80% of the time, with frequent worldwide travel, including on-shore and off-shore sites.
  • Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, along with good interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Be a leader with excellent listening, project management, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Be able to work effectively with customers at all organizational levels.
  • Have advanced computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn specialized BH applications and project management software like Primavera or Microsoft Project.
  • Be fluent in written and spoken English.


Desired

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Experience with TMS equipment.
  • Experience with Baker Hughes equipment, including scope of site operation, commissioning, and start-up.
  • Knowledge of Nuovo Pignone or Thermodyn CECO.
  • Knowledge of LM2500 turbines.


Work in a way that works for you

We recognize individual preferences and offer flexible working patterns, including offshore and onsite options.


Working with us

Our people are central to our success. We invest in their health, well-being, training, and leadership development to bring out the best in everyone.


Working for you

We offer a competitive benefits package, including work-life balance policies, private medical care, life insurance, disability programs, financial benefits, and voluntary perks.

About Us

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide innovative energy solutions. Committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050, we seek passionate individuals to help us make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient.

Join Us

Looking to make a difference in a global company? Join us and grow with a team that energizes and inspires you!

Baker Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and encourage candidates with disabilities to apply.

Privacy Notice

Personal data collected during the application process will be used for verification and stored securely, in accordance with our policies and applicable laws.
